correctness.rationale: The obstruction and section hold on periodic lifts to the bilateral lattice, including when sites repeat within a local window. Independently checked all 2^8 and 2^10 open contexts for the two forbidden F² outputs, and all 512 nine-bit contexts containing neither forbidden word for the center identity F²G²=id. Simultaneous 10→01 swaps independently gave the same full image, predecessor and density recurrence on every ring of lengths 1–13. In the suffix graph a path of at least five labels forces its state to the longest prefix suffix of those labels, independent of the start. A periodic allowed word therefore has one and only one closed walk based at the indexed cut. That proves trace normalization even on short rings and does not quotient by rotation. The nonloop simple cycles have lengths 2, 3 and 5 and weights u, u² and u³, with singleton loops of weights 1 and u. Including the disjoint-cycle terms in det(I−zT) cancels the contributions of degrees 2, 3 and 5, leaving 1−(1+u)z+u²z⁴+u³z⁶. Taking the logarithmic derivative and expanding the multinomial gives the rational and factorial formulas as stated. The unweighted graph is strongly connected with a loop, so the Perron root is simple and strictly dominant; the given factorization identifies it and trace gives leading constant one. The length-six word has no period below six and avoids 1100 in all six rotations, giving the exact first loss.
